annotations.text:
Current bimini.me homepage, recreated from the site source in the repo.
The distressed logo image and the Laylo sign-up embed are placeholders here.
Ask for changes in the Bimini Line chat and they land on this canvas.

A. RANSOM RIOT
Maximal punk collage: ransom-note type, stickers, tilted blocks, all three brand colours at once.
Why: the most unmistakably Bimini, turns the existing DNA up to 11.
Tradeoff: loud everywhere, needs discipline to stay scannable.

B. ZINE PRESS
Cream newsprint zine: huge Archivo Black masthead, mono listings, print energy.
Why: a genuinely new feel (light ground), gives the essays and podcast a real home.
Tradeoff: trades away the neon-club glow, energy comes from type not light.

C. ACID SIGNAL
Brutal club minimal: one acid accent, terminal type, rave-flyer date table.
Why: fastest to scan, most DJ-forward, phone-first.
Tradeoff: minimal leaves less room for collage warmth and chaos.
